subject.title: feat(control-ui): selection popup with More details and Ask in side chat via /btw

question: Should Control UI adopt this Codex-style text-selection popup after the state defects and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: This protected PR adds a new user-facing chat interaction; code correctness does not establish whether maintainers want the additional UI and lifecycle surface.

options.title: Adopt after repair
options.body: Land the feature after the three state-boundary defects are fixed and inspectable current-head proof is attached.

options.title: Keep manual `/btw`
options.body: Retain the existing command-only side-question workflow and decline the popup if its added interaction complexity is not desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair
recommendation.body: Land the feature after the three state-boundary defects are fixed and inspectable current-head proof is attached.
